$comment: Tier names to models. The only place in the pipeline a model appears — skills and templates name tiers, never models.
$comment_escalation: Brief 2 §6: repeated typecheck failure is a capability signal, repeated test failure is a specification signal. Only the former climbs this ladder; a test failure re-specs at the same tier.
$comment_default_drift: If two consecutive units both escalate, the default tier for this feature is wrong. Raise `tiers.executor` for the remainder rather than paying the escalation on every unit.
